name: Witchcrafter Pupils
effectText:
1 "Witchcrafter" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
During the Main or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects;
●Add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell from your Deck to your hand.
●Reveal 1 "Witchcrafter" Normal or Quick-Play Spell in your hand; apply that card's activation effect.
During your End Phase: You can return 1 of your banished "Witchcrafter" cards to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Pupils" once per turn.
